title: EditHints
description: The directed-edit block (docs/05-roadmap/directed-edit-test.md): the high-judgment edit decisions for one script, written outside the system by a Claude web pass and pasted under the script between ===LUSORA EDIT v1=== and ===END===. A human-provided artifact, applied by CODE onto the beat sheet — never a script of its own. Phrases (`from`, `at`) are verbatim spans of the script, located with the compiler's textmatch keys; everything derivable (anchor source_words, anchor_ref, overlay role) is deliberately absent so it cannot disagree with what code derives. No sound fields: a model never names a sound (D8/D50).

version.description: The block format. The paste markers already name it; optional here.

style_pack.description: An ASSERTION, not a choice: must equal the video's resolved style pack, because the component menu and budgets the edit pass was shown depend on it.

sections.description: In script order. The first starts at the script's first words. A beat takes the mood of the section holding most of its words.

from.description: the section's opening words, verbatim and unique in the script

mood.description: the D50 vocabulary. Stricter than beat.mood (a free string that degrades to neutral) because an attended author can fix a typo

pin.description: A decision attached to a verbatim phrase: an overlay, a key shot (visual_intent + queries — the 'hero'), or both. Code requires at least one of the two.

at.description: verbatim, unique in the script, starting at the words the graphic is about. Code copies the SCRIPT's own words into the anchor's source_words, so this is also where the overlay is timed.

anchor.description: the fact a fact-carrying overlay shows. No source_words (it is `at`) and no anchor_ref (it is always this anchor).

overlay.description: No role: the catalog derives it (D86) — a component with no anchor types is emphasis whatever anyone says.

visual_intent.description: scout-style description of the shot this moment needs; replaces the beat planner's on the beat holding `at`

queries.description: 2-3 keyword searches for the same shot (D53)
